data.description:
## Problem Statement

The test fixture `TestRootFileOnlyRepoManifest._init_repo` in `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` (~lines 481-548) creates a real git repo and runs `git init`, `git add -A`, and `git commit -qm "init"` against `tmp_path`. If `tmp_path`/TMPDIR resolution ever points at a live repository, the fixture stages the ENTIRE repo state and commits an "init" commit that deletes every tracked file except a 6-file placeholder set.

**Incident (2026-09-19):** this occurred during SA-0MU0X9CRI009QKKK implementation. Running `run_tests.py --scope full` in a worktree produced commit `2c30dbfe` ("init", author T <t@t.com>) that deleted 472 files / 138,009 lines. The corrupted HEAD was pushed to origin/dev (after the pre-push gate was bypassed) before it was detected and force-reverted via `74bd0437`. Damage was recovered; root cause remains unfixed.

## Evidence

- Fixture creates exactly: `install.sh`, `remote`, `sshl`, `update`, `ai.home.conf`, `tests/test_a.py`.
- Commit `2c30dbfe` tree contains exactly those 6 files; author identity T <t@t.com> and message "init" match the fixture exactly.
- `git diff origin/dev..2c30dbfe` = 472 files changed, 138,009 deletions.
- Recovery: origin/dev rewritten to `74bd0437` (fix re-applied); `2c30dbfe` verified NOT an ancestor of origin/dev.

## Suggested Fix Direction

1. Make `_init_repo` defensive: assert `tmp_path` is not inside the repo under test; refuse to run if the resolved path contains `.git` (or if `git -C <repo> rev-parse --show-toplevel` escapes the sandbox).
2. Investigate why `tmp_path`/basetemp resolved to the live repo during the incident (pytest TMPDIR/basetemp handling under the test-skill runner).
3. Add a guard in the fixture (e.g. `if (repo/"..").resolve() == REPO_ROOT: fail`) and a regression test that the fixture never mutates a repo outside the sandbox.
4. Optionally harden the implement/test runners to refuse destructive operations in worktrees (or run tests with a dedicated TMPDIR).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `TestRootFileOnlyRepoManifest._init_repo` can never commit into a repository other than its own tmp dir (guard + regression test).
2. Root-cause of TMPDIR/basetemp misresolution during the incident is documented (or eliminated).
3. Full audit test suite passes.
